ConnectionStrings._comment: Local dev: run 'dotnet user-secrets set ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection <your-conn-str>'. Production: set the CONNECTIONSTRINGS__DEFAULTCONNECTION environment variable. See README for details.

Auth._comment: Local dev: run 'dotnet user-secrets set Auth:ApiKey <secret>'. Production: set the AUTH__APIKEY environment variable.

Cors._comment: TODO: replace the placeholder Vercel URL with the real production domain once known. Override AllowedOrigins in production via the CORS__ALLOWEDORIGINS__0 / __1 environment variables.
